blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Monday expressed confidence that the state prosecutors will secure victory on the P75-million plunder case that Sen. Rodante Marcoleta and his co-accused former lawmaker Mike Defensor and two other businessmen are facing after their bail petitions were denied. Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano made this statement after the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday denied the bail petitions filed by Marcoleta and his three co-accused over the plunder case that stemmed from a campaign donation.
